settings._note: Swing levels on daily candles (the Stock Cockpit's swing.py), rebuilt once a day, re-measured hourly and with every radar scan. Backtested Oct 2026: at a level beat the market 54-58% of the time over 10 days, only in coins swinging under ~18% a week.

recent._note: Context on each row, not used to pick coins: 30-day swing support/ceiling from 4h candles and the 30-day and weekly VWAP. Tested Oct 2026: recent levels and VWAP pullbacks showed no edge; 10%+ above VWAP lagged (the 'stretched' tag).
